    "Relatively quick to get started for a small team."

  "cons": [
    "Some advanced features required a learning investment for optimal use.",
    "Custom reporting could be more flexible for specific business needs.",
    "Potential for minor hiccups with integrations during initial setup."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "As a CEO of a small outsourcing firm, the initial experience with Freshsales was largely positive, particularly appreciating its ability to centralize customer data and provide clear pipeline visibility for both B2B and B2C operations. While the core functionality proved highly valuable for managing customer relationships, there was a slight learning curve for maximizing advanced features. The platform offered good value, helping to streamline sales efforts effectively within the first six months of use."
